name: NEO high-frequency early-scout PAPER execution and isolated learning
policy: User authorized high-frequency EARLY PAPER scouting and learning from accumulated results. Existing PAPER account history is preserved; no reset, no live execution and no automatic live-money promotion.
integrity_note: Mandatory validated flow coverage, exact pool/mint checks, complete safety checks, one effective threshold object, bounded recorded quote latency and uncapped actual modeled losses.
runtime_note: Primary PAPER engine now prioritizes many small early scouts. Its own closed-trade journal adapts scout size after repeated mistakes; threshold/exit experiments still run in isolated learner books.
stop_execution_note: Planned net stop -5%; all observed gap losses and unavailable liquidation risk retained. Never clamps a loss or realizes native SOL as USDC.
